explication: agents-cli is a lifecycle CLI and skill suite for building, evaluating, deploying, and publishing ADK agents. The principal workflow is: a developer or coding agent invokes the CLI, lazy command dispatch selects a lifecycle operation, that operation creates or runs an agent project, evaluates it, deploys it to Google Cloud, and optionally registers it with Gemini Enterprise. Sampled code confirms command dispatch, authentication, deployment, publishing, generated runtime adapters, and shared session services; several command implementations remain unsampled, so those links are intentionally high-level.
